name: R2-10 mechanically auditable ALLOWED/FORBIDDEN feature table

prediction_instant.definition: A prediction for target routing event (t+h, l) is considered made at the causal instant immediately AFTER the predictor has observed the routing decision at (t, l) (the 'current' same-layer observation) and BEFORE any information from (t+h, l) exists. For h=1 this is the instant between observing (t,l) and (t+1,l) in the SAME-LAYER iterator order defined by Trace.token_selections(l, phase) (the exact unit R2-06 already established as the canonical token-to-token same-layer transition unit). 't' here indexes positions in that iterator's own yielded order, not raw token_index, because a layer need not route every token and R2-06 already established that consecutive must mean consecutive-in-iterator-order.
prediction_instant.horizon_semantics: h counts SAME-LAYER iterator-yielded steps, never raw token_index distance and never cross-layer steps. Target for horizon h at iterator position i is the entry at iterator position i+h of the SAME Trace.token_selections(l, phase) stream. h=1/4/16 are therefore 1/4/16 same-layer routing EVENTS ahead, which may correspond to a different number of raw tokens if the layer has gaps (see Trace.token_selections docstring); this is deliberate and documented so h is never silently reinterpreted as token or wall-clock distance.

allowed.definition: All (token_index, expert_set) entries yielded by Trace.token_selections(l, phase) at iterator positions <= i (current observation and everything causally before it in the same layer's own stream). Backing feature families: recency, cumulative_frequency, decayed_aged_frequency, same_layer_transition_history (all already allowed by prediction_contract.json.allowed_feature_families).

Routing outcomes at layers < l of the SAME step/token t, because they have already executed earlier in the same forward pass. Matches prediction_contract.json.input_time_semantics.allowed verbatim ('layers < l of the same step t').

Routing/cache-state history from any layer at steps that completed strictly before the step containing iterator position i. Backing feature family: cross_layer_routing_history (allowed, candidate, not established superior).
Deterministic internal state accumulated only from allowed events above (e.g. running counts, decay accumulators, last-seen maps). Must not be reset using any forbidden information.

forbidden.definition: The expert set E_{t+h,l} being predicted.

Any Trace.token_selections(l, phase) entry at iterator position > i (anything causally after the prediction instant in the same layer's own stream, including the entries strictly between i and i+h for h>1).
Any layer > l of the SAME step t containing iterator position i -- has not executed yet at the causal instant of prediction.
Any routing/cache event at a step occurring after the step containing iterator position i, regardless of layer.
Any EVAL trace, EVAL result, or post-hoc label not observable at runtime. R2-10 Phase 0 never opens experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/eval_manifest.json's locked contents.

mechanical_audit_requirement: argine/research2/r2_10/causal_walk.py's CausalEvent generator must be the SOLE path by which any R2-10 predictor code receives trace-derived data; it must structurally be unable to yield same_layer_future, same_step_later_layer, or future_steps_other_layers data at iterator position i. tests/test_r2_10_leakage.py enforces this empirically via a synthetic-trace future-alteration invariance test (see decision_rules.json.leakage_audit).
relation_to_prediction_contract: This table is a mechanical refinement of experiments/R2-09-prediction-benchmark/prediction_contract.json.input_time_semantics (intrastep_cross_layer_causal_context), not a replacement. Any conflict is resolved in favor of prediction_contract.json.
